text: The Windows11 MSIX xpcshell project route changes to an empty list. Its msix variant and target.installer.msix target stay declared, and the non-MSIX default still uses built-projects. This is a scoped project-selection change, not removal of xpcshell or MSIX packaging. The reported selftest hang and upstream matching behavior are unverified rationale; no task graph or native test ran.
title: MSIX xpcshell keeps its target and variant while its project route becomes empty
